funFacts: A detailed exterior model does not establish internal construction.

evidence.note: Downloaded geometry and teardown layout visually inspected; material conversion and internal reconstruction remain open.

sources.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro product and AR model

understanding.identityScope: Apple iPhone 18 Pro, eSIM, Burgundy; manufacturer AR exterior asset.
learningGoals: Distinguish externally visible product surfaces from the internal mechanisms still requiring reconstruction.

references.title: iFixit iPhone 18 Pro teardown
references.observation: Inspected the full-layout photograph: rounded burgundy housing, three circular camera openings, irregular board assemblies, metal battery enclosure and display reverse. These are not represented by the rejected primitive recipe.
references.limitations: Single teardown view does not establish every hidden surface, dimension or material. Pro and Pro Max share the article; the inspected layout is captioned Pro.

references.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro product and AR model
references.observation: Downloaded the manufacturer USDZ linked from this page. Flattened its USD payload and selected one device from the two-device arrangement. Inspected front and reverse renders.
references.limitations: AR is an exterior visualization. Its node names are obfuscated; 94 mesh surfaces are not 94 verified functional parts. Shader conversion still needs comparison.

components.function: Inspect the actual enclosure, camera housings and display as the reference for a researched internal reconstruction.

claims.statement: This sourced asset contains detailed exterior surfaces. It does not establish a complete internal assembly.

reconstruction.shape: Use the downloaded manufacturer geometry. Preserve curvature, lens layers, buttons and authored transforms. Extract one device from the paired marketing arrangement.
reconstruction.materialBehavior: Preserve mapped roughness, metalness, color and normal details; compare USD and GLB output under fixed lighting. Do not apply a single global shiny material.
reconstruction.hiddenSurfaces: Internal battery, board, cooling system and functional camera mechanisms are not verified in this model.
acceptanceChecks: Compare front, reverse and side renders against exact-model photographs.
Inspect lens-rim artifacts and glass response after USD to GLB conversion.
Verify one device, correct variant, dimensions and embedded textures.
Do not identify obfuscated mesh names as functional components without visual mapping.

unknowns: Redistribution of the Apple source asset is not established. Keep it out of the MIT repository.
Internal component geometry has not been acquired or built.
Small dark irregularities near a camera rim remain visible in the converted rendering.

unresolved: Full component reconstruction and export material review remain incomplete.

closing: This prototype separates functional assemblies. It does not yet reproduce exact internal construction.
artNote: Agent-authored spatial prototype. Published exterior dimensions; schematic internals, approximate finishes and no verified mechanical or electrical simulation.
